overrides.headline: Hot pies. Big subs. Butter chicken.
overrides.lead: Delivery across Towson, or pick up at 931 Taylor Ave.
overrides.tagline: Pizza, subs, wings and a desi kitchen in Towson, MD.

descriptions.Build Your Own Pizza: Pick a size, then toppings on the whole pie or just one half.
descriptions.Regular Tomato Cheese Pizza: Hand-tossed, our tomato sauce, whole-milk mozzarella.
descriptions.Meat Lovers Pizza: Pepperoni, sausage, ham, ground beef, bacon.
descriptions.Supreme Pizza: Pepperoni, sausage, peppers, onions, mushrooms, olives.
descriptions.Veggie Pizza: Peppers, onions, mushrooms, olives, tomatoes, spinach.
descriptions.Cheesesteak Sub: Shaved steak, American cheese, fried onions.
descriptions.Chicken Cheesesteak Sub: Chopped chicken, provolone, peppers and onions.
descriptions.Italian Cold Sub: Ham, salami, capicola, provolone, oil and oregano.
descriptions.Cheeseburger Sub: Ground beef, American cheese, lettuce, tomato, onion.
descriptions.Turkey Club Sandwich: Turkey, bacon, lettuce, tomato, mayo on toast.
descriptions.Butter Chicken: Tandoori chicken in a tomato butter sauce, basmati rice.
descriptions.Chicken Biryani: Layered basmati, spiced chicken, raita on the side.
descriptions.Chicken Tikka Masala: Charred chicken tikka in a creamy masala, basmati rice.
descriptions.Samosa: Two potato and pea samosas, tamarind chutney.
descriptions.Garlic Naan: From the tandoor, brushed with garlic butter.
descriptions.Tandoori Chicken: Yogurt and spice marinated, cooked in the tandoor.
descriptions.Chicken Quesadilla: Grilled chicken, peppers, cheddar jack, sour cream.
descriptions.Spaghetti with Chicken Parmesan: Breaded chicken, marinara, mozzarella over spaghetti.
descriptions.Meat Lasagna: Layers of pasta, beef ragù, ricotta, mozzarella.
descriptions.Cheeseburger: Hand-pressed patty, American cheese, the works.
